review.title: Review & quizzes
review.lead: Flip cards to review signs you have learned, or take the recognition quiz for a lesson.

review.lesson.heading: Lesson {n} · {title}
review.lessons.title: Quizzes by lesson
review.lessons.empty: There are no open lessons with at least two signs to quiz yet.
review.flash.title: Review with flashcards
review.flash.note: Remembered / Not yet only apply to this review session. They do not save progress or complete a lesson.
review.flash.no_js: Enable JavaScript to flip cards and choose a review source. The list of open lesson quizzes is still available alongside.
review.flash.empty.title: No cards in this source yet
review.flash.empty.body: View signs in a lesson, add a favorite or select By lesson to start reviewing.
review.flash.keyboard: Review card. Space or Enter to flip; left and right arrows to change cards.
review.flash.requeued: Moved “{word}” to the back of the queue to review again.
review.flash.marked: You marked “{word}” remembered for this session.
review.flash.done.title: You have reviewed this set
review.flash.done.body: You marked the cards in this source remembered. You can review again or take a lesson quiz.
review.video.label: Sign video for recognition
review.quiz.rule: A lesson is marked Completed when at least 80% of answers are correct. Your result is saved only when you open the final result screen.
review.quiz.no_js: Enable JavaScript to take and save the quiz. You can still read the lesson content and return to the lesson.
review.reading.title: Content in this lesson
review.quiz.video_question: Which sign is shown in this video?
review.quiz.keyboard: Choose with keys 1–4 or use Tab and Enter. Each question allows one choice.
review.quiz.incorrect: ✕ Not quite. The correct answer is “{word}”.
review.result.title: Quiz result
review.result.passed: At least 80% of your answers were correct. This lesson is now marked Completed. Keep reviewing and practising the signs.
review.result.again: Review the words you missed, return to the lesson and try again. The lesson state has been preserved.
